The head law is IMPORTED - every candidate comes out of queue_head.head_text and advancing past a blocked row only masks that row's leading marker in a copy of the text, so the line count stays honest and the same law is asked again - and the suite proves the import by patching it (a constant head then reads through as AC-PATCH). PRODUCT: src/os/followup_retry_history.py plus src/os/test_followup_retry_history.py - the house aggregate (followup_history --history) still judged every round from its canonical leg alone, so the four rounds a green retry had repaired were counted red and the aggregate could never read ALL-GREEN (live at R2303: rounds=427 red=412 with four retried rounds). The new reading is one pass over the whole directory whose per-round verdict and leg order are ASKED of followup_retry_legs (a patched joiner moves it - the suite proves it by replacing FR.history), splitting every round into four disjoint classes: green (canonical PASS, last PASS), recovered (canonical not PASS, last PASS), unfixed (canonical not PASS, last not PASS) and regressed (canonical PASS, last not PASS - reported instead of folded into green), with recovered + unfixed PARTITIONING the rounds whose canonical leg is not PASS and a count self-check that refuses E_FRH_COUNT if they ever stop partitioning. A round with no retry leg keeps exactly the followup_history reading (inherited, asserted key by key), and the naming law is asked of retry_naming so an orphan retry leg - invisible to the canonical-only collector - is REFUSED E_FRTL_ORPHAN_RETRY at exit 3 instead of dropping out of the counts. SUITE PASS 6/6 twice with an identical criterion digest, four adjacent followup suites green (retry_legs 6/6, history 7/7, retry_naming 9/9, evidence_variants 6/6), qa/followup-retry-history-R2325.log 1338B as one utf-8 LF single writer through the evidence_capture callable, one runner wiring line (os-followup-retry-history, 6). LIVE ON THE REAL PILE: rounds=438 green=20 retried=6 recovered=5 unfixed=413 regressed=0 verdict=HISTORY-DEBT - and the five recovered rounds are named (R2277, R2289, R2299, R2318, R2320), which is exactly the reading the canonical-only aggregate could never produce.
